activity.notes: The Swedish Riksdag selected Jean Baptiste Bernadotte as successor to the throne in 1810. ATLAS records the crown-prince phase separately from his later kingship and uses Sweden rather than retroactively treating the entire 1810–1818 period as royal rule over the Sweden–Norway union.
